title: Hide and Seek on the High Seas
section_path: Hide and Seek on the High Seas
section_path_text: Hide and Seek on the High Seas
summary:
Iranian crude oil exports continue to decline
Just when you think you have seen it all in the ongoing conflict between Iran and the United States, a report emerges that a representative of the U.S. State Department offered to pay millions of U.S. dollars to the master of the Iranian tanker Adrian Darya 1 to divert the disputed tanker to an American designated destination.
